Four cell lines were generated each expressing a distinct PrA-tagged mtRP: mS49 (gene name MRPS49; gene identifier DIPPA_31280), mS63 (MRPS63; DIPPA_25715), mL46 (MRPL46; DIPPA_18631) or mL76 (MRPL76; DIPPA_24761). As a control, we also generated a cell line with an ectopically expressed mitochondrially targeted PrA (mtPrA)
